title: 2D quantum spin Hall insulators: spin Hall plateaus

decision_points.fork: Where to put the chemical potential: the scf Fermi level (cold smearing 0.01 Ry) of the small-gap models lies inside the valence band, and the .win fermi_energy is the valence-band maximum
decision_points.wrong_choice: Evaluate the SHC at the Fermi energy printed by aiida.out (or at the .win fermi_energy)
decision_points.consequence: CuLi2As 0.38 instead of 1.0, Ti2I2N2 -0.106 instead of -0.852, Li2Tl2 0.52 instead of 2.786

decision_points.fork: Gap of the Wannier model versus the DFT band edges written in aiida.win: they come from the coarse scf grid; for Bi2In2 the Wannier valence-band maximum at a generic k lies above the .win mid-gap
decision_points.wrong_choice: Place mu at the mid-gap of the .win VBM/CBM comments

decision_points.fork: k-mesh convergence inside small gaps: the spin Berry curvature of Ti2I2N2 (22 meV gap) and Li2Tl2 (31 meV) is concentrated in hot spots that coarse meshes alias; dense or adaptively refined meshes are needed
decision_points.wrong_choice: Accept a 120 x 120 (or 60 x 60) mesh without refinement or a convergence test

decision_points.fork: Velocity-operator convention: Wannier functions at the lattice points (phase convention of the hr.dat) versus at their centres; the lattice convention breaks the crystal symmetry of the Kubo response, visible as a sigma^x_xy forbidden by the mirror of Bi2
decision_points.consequence: Bi2 spin direction theta/phi 38.813/42.425 instead of 31.776/89.755 deg; Hg4O2 plateau -0.863 instead of -0.758

decision_points.fork: Which calculation the archived spin Hall files describe: Top_materials holds relaxed structures (other lattice constants, Hf2Br2 cell rotated), not the database models; the paper table matches them
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the archived Top_materials plateaus (or the paper table) for the database models

decision_points.fork: Topology versus SHC magnitude: a large non-quantized in-gap SHC does not imply Z2 = 1 (Bi2In2 is trivial with a plateau near 0.8) and a plateau far from 1 does not imply a trivial insulator
decision_points.wrong_choice: Classify by the plateau magnitude (|sigma^z| >= 0.5 means QSHI)

decision_points.fork: Resolution of the Wilson-loop flow: near the small direct gaps of Ti2I2N2 and Li2Tl2 the hybrid Wannier centres wind quickly; a coarse sampling misses crossings
decision_points.wrong_choice: Trust a single 51 x 80 Wilson-loop calculation

decision_points.fork: Normalization: the service (like Wannier90) returns (hbar/e) S/cm with the vacuum-padded cell volume; the sheet value needs each material's cell height c and the unit e/2pi
decision_points.wrong_choice: Normalize by the atomic thickness of the layer, or report in units of e/4pi
decision_points.consequence: plateaus off by c/t (factors 3-10) or by 2

decision_points.fork: Spin axis of the plateau: low symmetry allows in-plane spin components (Bi2: sigma^y_xy; Hg4O2, P1: sigma^x_xy), so all three components must be computed
decision_points.wrong_choice: Compute only sigma^z_xy and take the spin along z
decision_points.consequence: theta 0 or 180 deg instead of 31.776 (Bi2) and 150.245 (Hg4O2)

graded_fields: plateau_sigma_z of 8 materials within max(3% of |ref|, 0.02) (hbar/e)(e^2/h)
spin_direction theta within 2.5 deg and phi within 5 deg for Bi2_P-3m1 and Hg4O2_P1

length_estimate.why: Eight models x (band edges, Wilson loop, converged spin Hall plateau) with resolution-dependent costs; the Fermi-level traps need the staged outputs read against the Wannier band edges, the position convention needs a symmetry test, and two canted plateaus need all three components.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy (runtime image); no extra layer
notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README): graded values are validated-evaluator values of the archived database Wannier models (the evaluator reproduces the archived aiida_band.dat to <0.1 meV with the Wigner-Seitz image selection, and gives sigma^x_xy = 0.002 / sigma^y_xy = 0.352 for Bi2, where the archived relaxed-structure Wannier90 run gives 0.009 / 0.356). The archive has no hr.dat for the relaxed Top_materials structures and no .spn files; Y2C2I2 (a metal, P1 in the database, in a rotated cell) was replaced by the canted plateaus of Bi2 and Hg4O2. Edge-state counts are a rubric item.
